description: Dependency updates as a routine (13/V6), after the same 7-day cooldown as uv and pnpm (13/V4).
Security fixes bypass minimumReleaseAge by Renovate's design: that is the urgent path (docs: key-concepts/minimum-release-age).
Base images and actions are pinned by digest and SHA (13/V3, V5); majors arrive one at a time, never grouped.
Not managed here: ops/tools.toml (each binary carries a sha256 that a human verifies; update by hand).
